input:
/home/eval/logs/access.log is an HTTP access log. Each well-formed line is: <timestamp> <method> <path> <status> <latency>ms, separated by single spaces. Produce /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv with per-endpoint latency statistics.

Rules:
- Skip lines that do not have exactly those 5 fields or whose latency is not a number followed by "ms" (e.g. truncation markers, or "-" for timed-out requests).
- endpoint = path with any query string ("?..." onwards) removed, then a trailing "/" removed (unless the path is just "/").
- Exclude /healthz and every path under /static/.
- For each endpoint: count = number of requests, p50 and p95 = latency percentiles in ms using the nearest-rank method (sort latencies ascending; the p-th percentile is the value at 1-based position ceil(p/100 * count)), err_permille = floor(1000 * (requests with status >= 500) / count).
- Output: tab-separated, a header line `endpoint	count	p50	p95	err_permille`, then the top 5 endpoints ordered by p95 descending, then count descending, then endpoint ascending (byte order). Integers only, no padding.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
LOG=/home/eval/logs/access.log
OUT=/home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
NORM=/tmp/norm.tsv

awk '
{
  line=$0
  if (line ~ /^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+$/) {
    n=split(line, f, " ")
    if (n==5) {
      latency=f[5]
      if (latency ~ /^[0-9]+ms$/) {
        path=f[3]
        status=f[4]
        q=index(path, "?")
        if (q>0) path=substr(path,1,q-1)
        if (path != "/" && substr(path,length(path),1)=="/") path=substr(path,1,length(path)-1)
        if (path=="/healthz") next
        if (path=="/static" || substr(path,1,8)=="/static/") next
        lat=substr(latency,1,length(latency)-2)
        # lat is numeric string; print
        print path "\t" lat "\t" status
      }
    }
  }
}' "$LOG" > "$NORM"

cut -f1 "$NORM" | LC_ALL=C sort -u > /tmp/endpoints.txt
cat /tmp/endpoints.txt

> /tmp/summary.tsv
while IFS= read -r ep; do
  [ -z "$ep" ] && continue
  # extract latencies sorted numerically
  safe=$(echo "$ep" | tr '/' '_')
  awk -F'\t' -v ep="$ep" '$1==ep{print $2}' "$NORM" | LC_ALL=C sort -n > "/tmp/lat_${safe}.txt"
  count=$(wc -l < "/tmp/lat_${safe}.txt" | tr -d ' ')
  err=$(awk -F'\t' -v ep="$ep" '$1==ep && $3>=500{c++}END{print c+0}' "$NORM")
  # percentile positions ceil(p/100*count)
  p50pos=$(( (50*count + 99)/100 ))
  p95pos=$(( (95*count + 99)/100 ))
  p50=$(sed -n "${p50pos}p" "/tmp/lat_${safe}.txt")
  p95=$(sed -n "${p95pos}p" "/tmp/lat_${safe}.txt")
  err_pm=$(( 1000*err / count ))
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ep" "$count" "$p50" "$p95" "$err_pm" >> /tmp/summary.tsv
  echo "ep=$ep count=$count err=$err p50pos=$p50pos p50=$p50 p95pos=$p95pos p95=$p95 err_pm=$err_pm"
done < /tmp/endpoints.txt

echo "--- summary unsorted ---"
cat /tmp/summary.tsv

# sort by p95 desc numeric, count desc numeric, endpoint asc byte
LC_ALL=C sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k4,4nr -k2,2nr -k1,1 /tmp/summary.tsv | head -n 5 > /tmp/top5.tsv
echo "--- top5 ---"
cat /tmp/top5.tsv

printf 'endpoint\tcount\tp50\tp95\terr_permille\n' > "$OUT"
cat /tmp/top5.tsv >> "$OUT"
echo "--- OUT ---"
cat "$OUT"
cat -A "$OUT"
EOS
chmod +x /tmp/build.sh
bash /tmp/build.sh

export LC_ALL=C
# independent verify: /api/items counts
grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [0-9]+ms$' /home/eval/logs/access.log | grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ /api/items/?(\?[^ ]*)? ' | wc -l
# breakdown lat sorted for items: get 191st and 362nd
grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [0-9]+ms$' /home/eval/logs/access.log | awk '{p=$3; sub(/\?.*/,"",p); sub(/\/$/,"",p); if(p=="")p="/"; if(p=="/api/items")print $5}' | sed 's/ms//' | sort -n | awk 'NR==191||NR==362||NR==1||NR==381{print NR": "$0}'
echo "--- items all sorted tail ---"
grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [0-9]+ms$' /home/eval/logs/access.log | awk '{p=$3; sub(/\?.*/,"",p); if(p!="/" )sub(/\/$/,"",p); if(p=="/api/items")print $5}' | sed 's/ms//' | sort -n | tail -n 30
echo "--- items err ---"
grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [0-9]+ms$' /home/eval/logs/access.log | awk '{p=$3; sub(/\?.*/,"",p); if(p!="/" )sub(/\/$/,"",p); if(p=="/api/items" && $4>=500)c++}END{print c+0, int(1000*(c+0)/381)}'
echo "--- verify all 6 endpoints alt method ---"
for ep in /api/cart /api/items /api/login /api/orders /api/search /api/users; do
  grep -E '^[^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [^ ]+ [0-9]+ms$' /home/eval/logs/access.log | awk -v ep="$ep" '{p=$3; sub(/\?.*/,"",p); if(p!="/" )sub(/\/$/,"",p); if(p==ep){print substr($5,1,length($5)-2);}}' | sort -n > /tmp/v.txt

  p50p=$(( (50*c+99)/100 )); p95p=$(( (95*c+99)/100 ))
  p50=$(sed -n "${p50p}p" /tmp/v.txt); p95=$(sed -n "${p95p}p" /tmp/v.txt)
  echo "$ep c=$c p50($p50p)=$p50 p95($p95p)=$p95"
done
echo "--- final file ---"
cat /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
ls -l /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv
# ensure no CR, tabs correct
od -c /home/eval/logs/out/report.tsv | head
